verses.1: And it was a very rich place for the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad. They saw that this land was fertile, and they also saw the land of Gilad. And behold, this place was indeed a rich place.
verses.2: And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben came and said to Moses, to the priest Eleazar, and to the leaders of the congregation, “…”
verses.3: Shepherds, shepherdesses, helpers, mourners, thinkers, Elalel, Sheba’m, Nvov, and Be’on.
verses.4: The land that Jehovah struck before the assembly of Israel is a new land, and it belongs to your servants.
verses.5: And they said, “If we find favor in your eyes, then give us this land as a possession for our servants. But do not let us pass through the Jordan.”
verses.6: And Moses said to the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, “You who are my brothers, you shall go into battle. And you shall stand there.”
verses.7: And why do you fill the hearts of the children of Israel with fear, so that they may not go into the land that Jehovah has given them?
verses.8: This is what your ancestors did when they sent them out of the Holy Land to see the land.
verses.9: And they went up to the valley of Eschkol. There, they saw the land. Their hearts were filled with joy because they could no longer enter the land that Jehovah had given them.
verses.10: And Jehovah smote him that day, and he was destroyed.
verses.11: If the people who come from Egypt are still alive after forty years, and they continue to inhabit the land that I promised to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob… then they will not be able to take over the land after me.
verses.12: I am not a dog born of beauty, nor a Kenez. I am a Joshua son of Nun. For they have filled themselves with Jehovah’s gifts.
verses.13: And Jehovah shall strike Israel, and He will make them cry out in the wilderness for forty years, until all those who do evil in the eyes of Jehovah are punished.
verses.14: And behold, you stand under your fathers; sinners who continue to defy the Lord God and Israel.
verses.15: For he will return from his place, and again he will be filled with strength to settle in the desert. And they will share it with all the people there.
verses.16: And they came to him and said, “We have sheep that are ready for us to raise them. We also have cities where we can live.”
verses.17: And we shall be freed from their oppression before the children of Israel, as long as they bring them back to their place and let them settle in the cities of the nations, away from the inhabitants of the land.
verses.18: I will not return to my home until the children of Israel have settled in their own land.
verses.19: For we were not allowed to cross over into the Jordan and the valley. For our inheritance came to us from beyond the Jordan, from the east.
verses.20: And Moses said to them, “Will you do this if you are forced to go into battle before Jehovah?”
verses.21: And let all your troubles pass away from you, through the Jordan River, before Jehovah. Let His enemies be removed from before you.
verses.22: And the land will be cleansed before Jehovah. After that, you shall return and be pure before Jehovah and before Israel. Then this land will become your possession before Jehovah.
verses.23: And if you do not do so, then see, your sin against Jehovah will be revealed to you. Know your sins, for they will be found out against you.
verses.24: May cities be built for your use, and towns for your habitation. And whatever comes from you shall be done.
verses.25: And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben said to Moses, “Your servants will do as my Lord commands.”
verses.26: Our sheep and cattle, as well as all our animals, will be there in the cities of Gilgal.
verses.27: And your servants will go forth from all ranks of the army before Jehovah for battle, as Adonai has commanded.
verses.28: And Moses commanded them Elazar the priest, Yehoshua son of Nun, and the leaders of the tribes of Israel.
verses.29: And Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben go with you into the Jordan River, then all those who are willing to fight before Jehovah will be killed. The land will be laid waste before you, and you will give them the land of Gilad as a possession.”
verses.30: And if the lice do not pass through you, and remain in your bodies in this land of Canaan.
verses.31: And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben replied, “As Jehovah has said to His servants, so it shall be done.”
verses.32: We will go through the processes of purification before Jehovah’s land, Canaan. And we will have control over our inheritance, from there to Jerusalem.
verses.33: And Moses gave them the queen of Sihon, king of the Amorites, and the queen of Og, king of the Bashan people, along with all their cities in the regions around those cities.
verses.34: And the sons of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Ezer.
verses.35: And the scornful ones, and those who help and support them.
verses.36: And the towns of Nimra and Haran were also cities belonging to Mibzar and Gidro.
verses.37: And the sons of Reuben built Keshbon, Elalel, and Kiryataim.
verses.38: And Nebo and Baal Meon Mousaboth, and Shibma. They named the cities after their names.
verses.39: And the sons of Machir, son of Manasseh, went to Gilgal. They captured it and took possession of it.
verses.40: And Moses gave the golem to Makir, son of Manasseh. And he settled him in that place.
verses.41: And Yair ben Menashe went and gathered his followers together. He called out to them, “Yair!”
verses.42: And Nebuzaradan went and gathered together Kenaan and his daughters. He called out to them, “Nebuzaradan.”
